**Probe-settled behaviour** (detail in spec/behaviour/sys-param.md): visible in every accepted configuration. MIN and
MAX choose b on ties and on NaN, and evaluate the chosen operand twice. howmany evaluates y twice and keeps a
howmany the program defined first. roundup masks for a compile-time power-of-two step (0 included); otherwise it
divides, evaluating y 3 times. powerof2(0) is 1. setbit and the other bit macros count in the array's own elements,
and isset gives the masked bit.

**Decisions.** None new (plan/headers.md 2.4 covers where the macros live). **Open questions.** None needing a
ruling. INFORMATIONAL: for negative x, `roundup` gives different results with a compile-time and a run-time
power-of-two step (probed; libniji matches; outside the man page's domain).
